<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_LuxuryAirplane" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/luxury-airplane">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Specifications" name="Customer Specifications"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_VodkaRequirements" name="Vodka Bar Requirements"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_WhiskeyRequirements" name="Whiskey Bar Requirements"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_OtherRequirements" name="Other Interior Requirements"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_VodkaBarParts" name="Vodka Bar Parts"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_WhiskeyBarParts" name="Whiskey Bar Parts"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_OtherParts" name="Other Interior Parts"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_TestProtocol" name="Test Protocol"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_DeliveredPlane" name="Delivered Airplane"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_DeliveryConfirmation" name="Delivery Confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_LuxuryAirplane" name="Luxury Airplane Production">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Manufacturer" name="Airplane Manufacturer" processRef="Process_AirplaneManufacturer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_RussianTeam" name="Russian Team"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_IrishTeam" name="Irish Team"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OtherTeams" name="Other Teams"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_SpecificationsToManufacturer" name="Specifications" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_Specifications"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_VodkaRequirements" name="Vodka bar requirements" sourceRef="Task_SendVodkaRequirements" targetRef="Participant_RussianTeam"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_WhiskeyRequirements" name="Whiskey bar requirements" sourceRef="Task_SendWhiskeyRequirements" targetRef="Participant_IrishTeam"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_OtherRequirements" name="Other requirements" sourceRef="Task_SendOtherRequirements" targetRef="Participant_OtherTeams"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_VodkaParts" name="Vodka bar parts" sourceRef="Participant_RussianTeam" targetRef="Task_ReceiveVodkaBarParts"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_WhiskeyParts" name="Whiskey bar parts" sourceRef="Participant_IrishTeam" targetRef="Task_ReceiveWhiskeyBarParts"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_OtherParts" name="Other parts" sourceRef="Participant_OtherTeams" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOtherParts"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_TestProtocolToCustomer" name="Test protocol" sourceRef="Task_SendTestProtocol" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_DeliveryToCustomer" name="Delivered airplane" sourceRef="Task_DeliverPlane" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ConfirmationToManufacturer" name="Delivery confirmation" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDeliveryConfirmation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_AirplaneManufacturer" name="Airplane Manufacturer Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Specifications" name="Customer specifications received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Specifications" messageRef="Msg_Specifications"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Requirements_Split" name="Distribute requirements"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendVodkaRequirements" name="Send vodka bar requirements" messageRef="Msg_VodkaRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendWhiskeyRequirements" name="Send whiskey bar requirements" messageRef="Msg_WhiskeyRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendOtherRequirements" name="Send other interior requirements" messageRef="Msg_OtherRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Requirements_Join" name="Requirements sent"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Parts_Split" name="Await parts"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveVodkaBarParts" name="Receive vodka bar parts" messageRef="Msg_VodkaBarParts"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveWhiskeyBarParts" name="Receive whiskey bar parts" messageRef="Msg_WhiskeyBarParts"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOtherParts" name="Receive other interior parts" messageRef="Msg_OtherParts"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Parts_Join" name="All parts received"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleInterior" name="Assemble interior"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestFlight" name="Perform test flight"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateTestProtocol" name="Create test protocol"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTestProtocol" name="Send test protocol to customer" messageRef="Msg_TestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DeliverPlane" name="Deliver airplane to customer" messageRef="Msg_DeliveredPlane"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDeliveryConfirmation" name="Receive delivery confirmation" messageRef="Msg_DeliveryConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Delivered" name="Airplane delivery confirmed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_Specifications" targetRef="Gateway_Requirements_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Gateway_Requirements_Split" targetRef="Task_SendVodkaRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Gateway_Requirements_Split" targetRef="Task_SendWhiskeyRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Gateway_Requirements_Split" targetRef="Task_SendOtherRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_SendVodkaRequirements" targetRef="Gateway_Requirements_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_SendWhiskeyRequirements" targetRef="Gateway_Requirements_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_SendOtherRequirements" targetRef="Gateway_Requirements_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gateway_Requirements_Join" targetRef="Gateway_Parts_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Gateway_Parts_Split" targetRef="Task_ReceiveVodkaBarParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_Parts_Split" targetRef="Task_ReceiveWhiskeyBarParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_Parts_Split" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOtherParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveVodkaBarParts" targetRef="Gateway_Parts_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveWhiskeyBarParts" targetRef="Gateway_Parts_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOtherParts" targetRef="Gateway_Parts_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_Parts_Join" targetRef="Task_AssembleInterior"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_AssembleInterior" targetRef="Task_TestFlight"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_TestFlight" targetRef="Task_CreateTestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_CreateTestProtocol" targetRef="Task_SendTestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_SendTestProtocol" targetRef="Task_DeliverPlane"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_DeliverPlane" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDeliveryConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDeliveryConfirmation" targetRef="End_Delivered"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
